advice.message: no pass is attached: nothing is held to approved addresses

enforcement.why: enforcement needs a pass and none is attached

lock.note: the lock stops the policy changing through teapot's own commands; it is not containment: a process sharing your shell can edit files, restart the engine or run other tools (use --enforce for containment)

pass.names: playpen does not enforce a destination's names: name rules are teapot's alone, enforced or not.
